entries.prompt:
Create a full-body isolated character portrait of Judges of the Dead from Greek mythology.

Character design: Depict Judges of the Dead, Arbiters of the Underworld, as all three judges—Minos, Rhadamanthus and Aeacus—as distinct mature or elderly kings seated or standing around one black-stone judgment tablet.
Recognizable attributes: Arbiters of the Underworld.
Identity guidance: The complete named ensemble is shown because the repository presents a stable group of 3; individual designs must remain consistent with their entries. Repository basis: The three mortal sons of Zeus appointed after death to judge the shades in the underworld as a reward for their justice in life: minos, rhadamanthus and aeacus.
Pose: arranged in a compact, layered three-quarter ensemble with every represented member fully visible and no floating portrait heads.
Composition: Complete compact ensemble of all 3 canonical members; use a wider full-body frame and keep every member and attribute inside the safe area.
Controlled supernatural accent: ember violet; keep it below fifteen percent of the subject.

Render in a consistent dark mythological realism aesthetic: premium cinematic Greek mythology character and creature design, photorealistic fantasy CGI, physically believable anatomy and materials, imposing ancient presence, majestic but dangerous, grounded realism with restrained supernatural elements. Use extremely detailed PBR materials and realistic micro-textures: pores, wrinkles, scars and natural imperfections in skin; individually resolved fur and hair; organic feathers, scales, horn and bone; hand-forged metal with scratches, oxidation, hammer marks, dents and age; thick, worn, hand-crafted leather. Use a restrained ancient Mediterranean palette dominated by charcoal, obsidian, iron gray, weathered bronze, ancient gold, dark brown and bone ivory, with the specified accent occupying less than fifteen percent of the subject. Illuminate with dark-to-neutral cinematic studio key light, warm amber-bronze rim light, deep detailed shadows, strong silhouette separation, realistic specular reflections and restrained internal illumination without excessive bloom. Use premium character-photography optics near an 85 mm equivalent perspective, a subtle low angle where appropriate, sharp facial or defining-feature detail, controlled depth of field, global illumination, ray-traced reflections, realistic subsurface scattering and displacement-level surface detail. Premium AAA game cinematic character quality with 8K-quality source detail.

Output requirement: 2048 × 2048 square PNG with true RGBA transparent alpha. Keep the entire subject inside an approximately ninety-percent safe area. Do not crop feet, hands, weapons, wings, horns, tails, heads or accessories. Isolate the subject completely: no scenery, environment, floor, ground shadow, pedestal, landscape, smoke backdrop, gradient, halo or checkerboard pattern. No text, typography, border, frame, watermark or logo.
